verifications.claim: President Donald Trump fired Pam Bondi as U.S. Attorney General on April 2, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Trump fired Bondi on April 2'; R1: 'fired Attorney General Pam Bondi Wednesday'; R3: 'President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi on Thursday' (article dated 2026/04/02)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm the firing; R2 directly states April 2, 2026, with others aligning on timing around early April 2026 without contradiction.

verifications.claim: Pam Bondi had a 14-month tenure as U.S. Attorney General.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Bondi’s firing ends a turbulent 14-month term'; R4: 'after just 14 months'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in R3 and R4.

verifications.claim: Trump reportedly fired Pam Bondi due to frustrations regarding her handling of the Epstein files.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'frustrations for months over her handling of the Epstein files'; R1: 'promise to release the entirety of the Jeffrey Epstein files... left Americans frustrated'; R2: 'her handling of the Epstein files, or rather her failure'; R4: 'criticism for her handling of the Jeffrey Epstein case'
verifications.reasoning: All sources directly link firing to Epstein files handling frustrations.

verifications.claim: Trump reportedly fired Pam Bondi due to a perceived lack of prosecutions against his political opponents.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'failed efforts to prosecute his political enemies'; R2: 'failed to lock up all the president’s political enemies... lack of “evidence”'; R4: 'frustration over her lack of prosecutions of his political enemies'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support in multiple sources for frustration over lack of prosecutions of opponents.

verifications.claim: Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche was named to replace Pam Bondi as U.S. Attorney General.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche will serve as interim attorney general'; R3: 'replacing Ms. Bondi with Todd Blanche, her deputy, on an interim basis'; R4: 'Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche... will lead the department'
verifications.reasoning: All confirm Blanche named as interim/acting replacement.

verifications.claim: Reports suggested Lee Zeldin was under consideration to replace Pam Bondi as U.S. Attorney General.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The president is reportedly considering replacing Bondi with Environmental Protection Agency Director Lee Zeldin'; R3: 'Lee Zeldin... whose name was floated for the job'
verifications.reasoning: Direct reports of Zeldin under consideration.

verifications.claim: Sources cited frustration with Pam Bondi's management of the Department of Justice.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Trump was preparing to replace Bondi... dissatisfied with her performance'; R3: 'privately venting his frustrations for months over her handling... shortcomings as a communicator'
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention dissatisfaction and frustrations with performance/handling, but in broader or specific terms rather than directly 'management of the DOJ'.

verifications.claim: Sources cited frustration with Pam Bondi's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'her promise to release... Jeffrey Epstein files... lack of new information left Americans frustrated'; R3: 'handling of the Epstein files'; R2: 'her handling of the Epstein files'; R4: 'handling of the Jeffrey Epstein case'

verifications.claim: Sources cited Pam Bondi's failure to initiate specific investigations demanded by the President.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'tried to fulfill Mr. Trump’s demands — launching investigations and trying to indict... but came up short'; 'inability to secure indictments'
verifications.reasoning: Sources indicate she launched investigations but failed to secure indictments/prosecutions, contradicting 'failure to initiate investigations'.

verifications.claim: Pam Bondi described her time as Attorney General as "the honor of a lifetime".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '"Leading President Trump’s historic... has been the honor of a lifetime"'; R3: '"the honor of a lifetime"'; R4: 'called her time as A.G. the honor of a lifetime'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote confirmed in multiple sources.
